facts.fact: The Commission for Information Technology and Freedoms (CIL) of Burkina Faso co-signed the 23 February 2026 joint statement, represented by its Director of Legal Affairs and Litigation, as a data protection authority.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's National Commission of Data Protection (CNPD) co-signed the 23 February 2026 joint statement, signed by its President Faustino Varela Monteiro.
Ghana's Data Protection Commission co-signed the 23 February 2026 joint statement, signed by Executive Director / Commissioner Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo and two other officers.
Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner co-signed the 23 February 2026 joint statement, signed by Deputy Data Commissioner Oscar Otieno.

facts.fact: The Mauritius Data Protection Office co-signed the 23 February 2026 joint statement, signed by Data Protection Commissioner Drudeisha Madhub.
